2 Jack next to historian comparing an old manuscript and historical castle plan, quill and books clearly visible. Text: A historian is someone who studies and writes about history.
3 Annie holds and points at physical wooden motte-and-bailey model: high earth mound with timber KEEP, lower enclosed BAILEY, tall wooden PALISADE and access ramp. Model dominates panel. Text: This kind of castle is called a motte and bailey castle.

6 Both Jack and Annie stand beside detailed castle architectural model showing keep, towers, curtain wall, moat, gatehouse, drawbridge, barbican and internal stable. Two balloon tails. Text: Turn the page to see how all the different parts of a castle fit together.
7 Jack beside large complete fortified castle scale model, his hand indicates outer walls, land, moat and barbican as well as inner residence.
